title.en: Delineating the Functions and Responsibilities of the Philippine Ports Authority and the Manila International Port Terminals, Inc. in Relation to the Management of the Manila International Port
title.orig: Delineating the Functions and Responsibilities of the Philippine Ports Authority and the Manila International Port Terminals, Inc. in Relation to the Management of the Manila International Port

source.url: LawPhil (source has HTML full text only)

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 EO_00571_1979_html.txt

text.en:
The management of the facilities and structures as well as the collection of dues as provided for by the
Revised Tariff Code in the Manila International Port is the main responsibility of the Philippine Ports
Authority. The Philippine Ports Authority shall also be responsible for the collection of cargo handling fees
which it shall remit daily to the Manila International Port Terminals, Inc;

All laws, decrees, charters, executive orders, administrative orders, proclamations, rules and
regulations or parts thereof that are in conflict with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 5th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Nine.
